attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) across their transit link, joining node3's private network (behind node1) with node4's private network (behind node2). Discovered and worked around a platform-level stale-flow blackhole on node2's node4-facing NIC by re-addressing the link, and fixed an OPNsense WireGuard/config.xml bug (missing required enabled field breaks template rendering) plus a boot-ordering issue (opt3 reconfigure strips the wg0 tunnel address) via a native rc.syshook fixup script. Verified end-to-end ICMP connectivity between node3 (10.10.13.2) and node4 (172.20.20.2) through the tunnel, confirmed only encrypted UDP/51820 crosses the transit link, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all four nodes with boot-identity and full-recovery verification for each.
